app.name: DracaSys
app.subtitle: Intelligent Deployment Helper — Live Demo
app.description: Parallel inference across four ML modules on live container telemetry. Each module runs independently — no output feeds another.

m1.title: Long-Term Forecasting
m1.subtitle: Prophet + GRU — 24h CPU Forecast
m1.approach: Hybrid decomposition: Prophet captures trend and daily seasonality per container; a GRU residual model corrects Prophet errors. Prophet is refit on each request from the supplied history.
key_details: 672-step (7-day) history recommended for best Prophet fit
5–30 s latency per request (Prophet refit at inference)
CPU percent only — not derived from the 15 s M2/M3 demo stream

m2.title: Short-Term Prediction
m2.subtitle: Adaptive GRU — CPU & Memory
m2.approach: Three horizon-specific AdaptiveGRU models (H1/H2/H3) forecast four resource targets from a 1000-step window of 27 engineered features (7 raw metrics + lag/rolling features).
key_details: 15-second sampling required — model trained exclusively at this cadence
Frozen normalization stats from training bundle — never recompute live
Forecasts compared against streamed actual readings in the demo

m3.title: System Anomaly Detector
m3.subtitle: Variational Autoencoder (VAE)
m3.approach: VAE-alone scorer: 30×7 metric window → scale → PCA → VAE reconstruction. Anomaly when reconstruction MSE exceeds a fixed calibrated threshold.
key_details: Detects CPU saturation, memory leaks, pod failures
Stateless — same input always produces same score

m4.title: Security Anomaly Detector
m4.subtitle: Sequence Bottleneck Autoencoder
m4.approach: Unsupervised Sequence Bottleneck AE trained on benign CICFlowMeter windows. Attack traffic reconstructs poorly → higher anomaly score.
key_details: Benign-only training — no attack labels required
Demo uses real verified attack window from test set (CVE-2020-13379)
